item.title: 【General Music Discussion】POLL: Who are the greatest pop star stars of all time?
item.description:
Hi everyone,


I invite you all to take part in a new poll I am doing for my POP IMMORTALS YouTube channel.

You just need to rank your top 10 favourite pop stars.

https://surveyswap.io/surveys/c9670bef-6ff3-4094-a5d5-442a3d6134ea/take-a-survey

I will be sharing the results in a video similar to this one I made about 'Madonna's Most Iconic Moments' which some of you here may have seen The results will be posted at the end of the year with little recaps of each artist.
